remarks: Discover this stunning rental with brand new appliances, freshly painted interior, and rare two full bathrooms. A perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Can be partially furnished or unfurnished. This spectacular 2 bedroom & 2 bath with "in-unit" garage & plenty extra street parking. Main level ALL hardwood floors. Upper level bedrooms, hall and loft level with wall to wall carpet. Master bedroom has cathedral ceiling & overlooks complex heated pool/clubhouse. The unit main entrance faces the gorgeous pool. It's just 5-minutes to Merritt Pky (exit 36), 10 minutes to I-95 & stone's throw to Hope St.-State Theater/walk to Springdale school, train, restaurants. Looks almost new. Balcony off kitchen on main level. Crown molding & hardwood floors for living room/dining area & half bath. Upper level/bedrooms/full bath/linen closet. Master bedroom has walk-in closet. Carpeted Loft could be guest-room, TV, office or playroom-has pull-down attic for storage. Newer Washer/dryer on finished lower level w/storage closets & garage. Amazing laundry area with stone counter and stainless slop sink with cabinets. Separate walk-in entrance at garage level. Garage has a new work bench, cabinets and tool kit. Complex has beautiful pool & clubhouse with billiard table/workout gym. Visitor parking.
